capabilities: enable theme features from a settings panel
disambiguation: Only configures the Oxygen theme; it does not add settings to other themes.
extras: README does not list the actual settings or options provided; it only covers installation, requirements and credits. Part of a Vault CMS project for Astro sites.
intentEvidence: Settings plugin for Oxygen Theme. Forked from Minimal Theme Settings.
problem: Customizing a theme in Obsidian normally requires editing CSS snippets by hand; this gives Oxygen theme users a settings interface instead.

relations.evidence: Optional: Style Settings plugin for more specific tweaks if desired
Baseline theme for the animation effects and some feature ideas.
Meridian theme for the auto-hide animations for the file explorer icons
Maple theme for the background blur effect.

summary: Settings panel plugin for the Oxygen theme that exposes theme customization options, forked from Minimal Theme Settings.
